title: Clear both hosts-guard libs and fix the done-redirect instrument artifact
objective: Bring hosts_guard_migrate.sh and hosts_guard_rollback.sh to 100% measured line coverage and remove both allowlist exemptions, extending continuation_lines() so a loop terminator carrying a redirect stops being counted as an unreachable statement.
acceptance_criteria: Both libs measure 100.00% through tests/run_all.sh at --min 100 with --fail-on-case-error, exiting 0.
check_shell_coverage.sh passes on both with their allowlist lines already deleted.
The new _LOOP_END_OP predicate excludes ONLY lines where `done` is followed by a redirect or pipe; a bare `done` stays in the denominator so real uncovered loops are still caught.
An audit printing every newly-excluded line with its text shows exactly the two lines in hosts_guard_rollback.sh and nothing else across fixes/lib.
The instrument acceptance pair still measures exactly: dot_resolver_install.sh 39/39 and rpi_nc_ca.sh 73/73, through features/lib/tests/run_all.sh with its jail_args.
Both libs keep their production behaviour: every new seam defaults to the real path it replaced.
The suite stays green and shellcheck reports nothing, with zero suppressions.
out_of_scope: The backslash-continued-assignment artifact that caps bt_adapter.sh at 98.55%; it is a different predicate and only affects one line in one lib.
arch_sysctl_quarantined_cases.sh, which stays outside the suite.
The last two untested libs, ubuntu_perf_fixes.sh and nvidia_config.sh.
verifier: timeout 900s bash meta/scripts/shell_coverage_jail.sh --timeout 600s --subject linux_configuration/scripts/single_use/fixes/lib/tests/run_all.sh --measure hosts_guard_migrate.sh (then hosts_guard_rollback.sh) --min 100 --fail-on-case-error -- "", then the acceptance pair through features/lib/tests/run_all.sh, then check_shell_coverage.sh on both libs.
